**Finding submitted — deviation (RENEWAL), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4.1 (p0024) is the only renewal provision; searches for renewal, term, price/fee increase and the Section 3 fee provisions (p0018–p0022) confirm no other renewal or uplift mechanic exists.
- **Analysis:** Renewal is automatic for successive **one-year** terms (acceptable term length), but exit requires **90 days'** written notice — above the 60-day fallback ceiling and at the walk-away boundary. Fees are a fixed 30% Net Sales revenue share with no renewal price-increase right, so the conditional price-cap element is not triggered (mapped as already met on the renewal sentence itself).
- **Redline:** single surgical swap of "ninety (90) days written notice" → "sixty (60) days written notice", leaving all other Section 4.1 wording, the Termination Date definition and the Section 4.2 Termination Payment machinery untouched.
- **Noted but not flagged:** no vendor renewal reminder and no CPI/3% uplift cap (preferred-level refinements only); the mutual 90-day right is treated solely as natural-term non-renewal under this rule, not as vendor termination for convenience.
